dedupe_keys.name: global airborne observatory mapped infrastructure on hawaii island

description: Arizona State University researchers publish three mapped building layers for Hawaiʻi Island. Zenodo supplies GeoTIFF rasters free under CC BY 4.0. The maps were derived from Global Airborne Observatory laser scanning and imaging spectroscopy using a convolutional neural network followed by gradient-boosted trees. The describing article reports coverage across approximately 3,200 square kilometres of varied landscapes. These maps can supply building-exposure inputs to flood, wildfire and wastewater infrastructure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these island maps. Coverage is three mapped regions, not a statewide parcel register. The source paper notes difficult labels for small structures and confusion between closely spaced buildings, which affect exposure counts. Raster coding, acquisition dates and positional uncertainty require checking before asset-level use. No GeoTIFF was downloaded or detection accuracy recomputed.
name: Global Airborne Observatory: Mapped Infrastructure on Hawaii Island
